notes.title: Nightside price drop
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you may have noticed, Nightside's price has dropped significantly. That is mainly because we are no longer able to maintain the game with updates and multiplayer servers and we feel that the adjusted price is just right for what the product has to offer at this time. We hope we'll be able to create Nightside 2, a much better follow up to the first installment.

Also, the game is on a significant sale this week on Steam!

notes.title: "THE NOXX" FREE DLC RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]THE NOXX[/b] free DLC is now live! Here are the features that it comes with:

* NIGHTSIDE is now a [b]four races[/b] RTS
* players can now play against 2 AIs and/or ally with an AI in VERSUS AI game mode
* added "free for all" game mode in VERSUS AI 
* added 2 more 4 players maps
* added 2 more music tracks
* added "formation move" functionality - groups of units of different types will now move at the speed of the slowest moving unit
* improved UI
* added tutorial mission for The Noxx
* a lot of gameplay improvements and bug fixes based on the community's feedback

NOTE 1: this is a free DLC - the game will update itself, no need to activate it in any way

NOTE 2: players who tried the unofficial DLC builds can now switch back to the main branch by going to LIBRARY > right-click on NIGHTSIDE > Properties > BETAS > from the drop-down select "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs" > CLOSE

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2 RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Our second patch for Nightside is now live! Here are the fixes that come with it:

* units will now always execute the attack or move commands (no more "rogue" units)
* a double-tap is now required in order for the camera to zoom on an units  control group
* Missions "Retaliate" and "Conquer" made easier on Easy AI
* Nova Predator price is now 140 in the "The Nova" mission as it is in the rest of the game
* fixed an issue with YX buildings that made them teleport on short distances when issued a move command
* fixed an issue with units sometimes building forever when pausing the game
* YX cell price adjusted to 50 in all game missions
* fixed an issue with the YX Mastermind teleporting when selkected together with cells and issued a "hold ground" command
* YX Guardian structure HP increased from 500 to 650
* Human Protectors will now always detect and attack the enemy
* fixed an issue that prevented transporters to carry Human units in the "Alliance" mission 
* YX air units no longer can dismantle over unpassable terrain and so resulting in dismantled cells loss
* fixed an issue that allowd selecting the same unit using CTRL more than once 
* fixed an issue that prevented creating more cells when the maximum number was reached
* mouse is no longer trapped inside the game window in windowed mode
* made the double click on a unit/building more responsive (for selecting units/buildings of the same type)
* added a special .bat executable for people running the game on Integrated Graphics video cards and experiencing rendering issues

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE PATCH 1.0.1 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our first post release patch (version 1.0.1) is now live!
Here are the fixes/changes that come with it:

[b]FIXES[/b]

* fixed an issue that occurred to some players that prevented advancing past the 1st Story mission
* fixed crashes and gameplay issues that occurred on certain Linux versions 
* fixed a crash that occurred on Windows in the initial loading screen
* fixed the positioning of quick select buttons - they are now visible in all situations
* fixed an issue that made certain buildings/units to teleport to their initial position when using the "hold ground" command
* fixed an issue that sometimes made the Story missions quest to display debug text

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

* Easy AI has been nerfed (it now extracts fewer resources, it will not attack with air units in early game, it takes more time to build units)
* improved the "quick select" buttons (the ones located next to the minimap) graphics to better reflect their role 
* added a message in 2v2 Multiplayer Lobby that informs the server host that he can switch player teams by dragging player names over other player names
* the Nova buildings will no longer deselect when lifted
* camera will no longer zoom to a control group when directly pressing on that control group's number

[b]BALANCE[/b]

* YX Dominator cost increased from 7 to 8 cells
* YX Dominator HP decreased from 600 to 480
* YX Recon speed decreased from 4.8 to 4.1
* NOVA Predator cost decreased from 180 to 140

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE FULLY RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After a 7 days Greenlight campaign and 4 months of Early Access we are proud to announce that NIGHTSIDE is now FULLY RELEASED! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XQrcou3P45Q

We want to thank the community for such a great feedback that surely helped us build a better RTS! The Full Release comes with graphics improvements, performance optimization, smarter AI, balancing changes and lots of bug fixes.

Although Nightside is now fully released this is definitely not the end of updates for our game. We plan on regularly releasing new content for the game and players that will finish the Story mode will surely guess what the first big update will be about. As usual if you find any issues with the game don't hesitate to post them on the forum and we'll release fixing patches asap!

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE UPDATE 9
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Nightside Update 9[/b] is now live! 
This is the last update before going out of Early Access into Full Release next week. We're still aiming for a Tuesday, 4th of August for release but if we find issues that take more time to solve we might delay a day or two. 
So here are the most important changes that come with this update:

* [b]STORY MODE COMPLETE[/b] - all 14 missions and cutscenes are final - yes we said that we're going to keep the end of story for release but why not give it a few days earlier (and trust us, there's a big surprise there!)

* improved AI - the AI now uses abilities
* 2 new 1v1 maps (both are large size)
* follow mechanic - right-clicking on a unit while havin other unit/units selected will make them follow that unit
* improved visuals in most of the levels
* added the option to toggle on/off the vertical line visible under air units

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE UPDATE 7 - NIGHTSIDE BETA
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Nightside BETA[/b] is live and here are the main additions that come with it:

[b]STORY[/b]

* Added Chapter III (4 missions - Human) - ALL STORY MISSIONS ARE NOW AVAILABLE
* Made a lot of improvements on the previous 9 missions
* Improved the pre-mission narration screens
* Added difficulty options

[b]MULTIPLAYER[/b]

* Added 2v2 mode with 4 maps available
* Added CO-OP vs AI mode with 4 maps available
     - this mode can also be used to play single against 2 AIs
     - this mode can also be used as player+AI vs player+AI
* Added Matchmaking system
* Added Leaderboards 

[b]VS AI[/b]

* Added 2 new maps - large and medium
* Tweaked the AI difficulties

[b]OTHER[/b]

* Re-worked all menus
* Added re-searchable defensive abilities for Nova Mothership, YX   Mastermind and Human Fortress
* Multiple buildings can now be selected and issued commands (press TAB to switch between selected buildings)
* Added queued basic units commands (move, hold ground, attack ground)
* Added small symbols on the production icons that show what the unit is capable of attacking (air/ground)
* Added unit/building select sounds (specific to every race) 
* The camera zoom speed can now be adjusted in the Gameplay Options menu
* ground units can now better find pathfinding around buildings


NOTES:

* this is our biggest update since we launched on Early Access so there might be issues that we overlooked. Please report any of them on the forum and we'll get them fixed ASAP
 
* now that we are feature complete with Nightside we will now concentrate on bug-fixes and improvements until the final release on the 4th of August, so expect 2-3 more updates before the game fully releases


Good luck! Have fun!

notes.title: UPCOMING NIGHTSIDE BETA AND FINAL RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Nightside Beta is just a few days from release[/b]. That means that the game will have all its features implemented with only bug fixes, optimization and improvements remaining for us to work on. We also established the final release date for the [b]4th of August[/b]. Here are the main additions to the game that will come with the Beta:

* all Story missions along with all the cutscenes and narration (though we'll going to keep the end of the story as a surprise for the game's final release)
* Story difficulty options and lots of missions tweaking
* 2v2 multiplayer with 4 maps available
* CO-OP vs AI multiplayer
* multiplayer matchmaking and ladder system for both 1v1 and 2v2 games
* 2 more 1v1 VS AI/multiplayer maps
* researchable deffensive abilities for Mothership/Mastermind/Fortress
* all menus re-worked
* a lot of gameplay improvements including multiple buildings selection and queued commands

...and much more

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE UPDATE 3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Nightside update 3 is now live and here are the new additions to the game!

* 3 new unit abilities (1 for each race)

   NOVA

    DISABLE WEAPONS - can be activated by the STAR unit (must by researched at the Drone Factory) – the Star creates rays that disable up to 5 enemies' weapons for a certain period of time

    YX

       BOOST WEAPONS – can be activated by the VECTOR unit (must be researched at the WAR TECH facility) – the Vector will boost all nearby units' weapons damage by 30% for a certain period of time

    HUMAN

       VORTEX – can be actived by the MOTH unit (must be researched at the LABORATORY) – the Moth creates a Vortex that attracts all enemy fire for a certain period of time

* 2 new 1v1 maps, medium and large sizes
* 3 new music tracks (1 for each race)
* added map size labels in the versus AI menu
* the already explored areas will now have a "mapped terrain" effect in the game world (different for each race)
* added shield bars in addition to the existing HP bars
* drag selection on an a group of units containing extractors/collectors/gatherers will no longer select the  extractors/collectors/gatherers
* Options are now also available in the in-game menu
* Added the following gameplay options:
       - camera sensitivity
       - Health/Shield bars on/off
* added tooltips to all hud icons (abilities, quick select buttons, etc.)
* added "resources depleted" on screen message
* fixed some hud display issues on 16:10 and 4:3 aspect ratio resolutions
* fixed an issue with the game running on 32-bit systems

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE UPDATE 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The second update for Nightside is here!
Here are the new additions and improvements:


* more challenging AI on all difficulty levels
* "modular" HUD - only the necessary parts of the HUD will be displayed on-screen (e.g. if nothing is selected only the minimap, timer and control groups will be displayed)
*  explored areas will now be visible on the minimap (next update will also bring an effect on the explored terrain in the game world)
*  1 new 1v1 map - large size, as requested by the community
* tuning on all the three races to differentiate their play style even further
        - NOVA now has a speed bonus
        - YX now has a vision bonus
        - HUMAN now has a resilience bonus
* implemented YX Cells cap (limited to max 80) as the performance can drop when having many unused Cells 

             
 Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE UPDATE 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just released our first weekly update of Nightside. Here are the new features that were added to the game:

* added 3 new abilities to the scouting units for better map exploration:

      - the Nova SCOUT unit can now launch detector Light Drones (researchable from Mothership)
      - the YX RECON unit can now initiate Scanner for longer range detection (researchable from Mastermind)
      - the Human PROBE unit can now drop detector Torches (researchable from fortress) 

* a new 1v1 map has been added 
* resources batches now have 2700 units instead of 2000
* unit/building information has been added to the hud (hp, dps, speed, shield)
* when creating control groups small numbers will be displayed next to the unit/building's health bar
* abilities countdown graphics - the player can now see how much time is required until the ability is available
* the camera can now be further zoomed in or out 
* camera can now be panned by holding middle mouse pressed
* added race names in versus AI/Training menus

Good luck, have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSIDE EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Nightside Steam Early Access is now available!
Here are the main features that will be available in this first version:

* Graphics are 90% complete
* Gameplay mechanics for all the three races featured in the game are 90% complete.
* AI opponents are implemented for all the three races and AI mechanics are 75% complete
* The player can play 1v1 battles against AI opponents (three difficulty levels are available)
* Four 1v1 levels are available for playing against the AI (also will be used for 1v1 multiplayer later)
* Three “Training” missions are available (1 for each race) that can help the players get used with the game mechanics.
* DRM free

After this initial release we will follow with often updates with improvements and fixes (most probably weekly updates). The first major update will include local and online multiplayer and we estimate it will be delivered at the end of April 2015.

Final release is currently set for 31st of July 2015 and will add the following features:

* Story driven campaign mode featuring 13 missions
* Local and Online Multiplayer for 2-4 players with both ranked and unranked modes
* 4 additional 1v1 multiplayer levels
* 4 2v2 multiplayer levels
* 9 additional units special abilities (3 per race)
* Spectator mode for multiplayer matches
